label: Week 24, 2026
recap:
This week, activity centered mainly on the United States Congress, which accounted for 19 of the 34 recorded bill movements, alongside smaller amounts of activity in Louisiana, Pennsylvania, Arizona, New Jersey, and Rhode Island, with one movement each in California and Delaware. Across these 9 jurisdictions, no cases were updated and no federal documents were logged, so the picture is limited to legislative record changes rather than litigation.

Among the themes that appeared, transparency and disclosure was the most common, with 5 bills touching on labeling AI-generated content or impact assessments. Children and minors followed with 4, and criminal law and infrastructure and energy each had 3. Elections, employment and hiring, health care, and workforce and education each showed 2 bills. Fifteen bills did not fall under any tracked theme. Overall, this was a modest week of scattered legislative movement without major concentration in any single area.
